subject: executor: fix flaky test TestIndexJoin31494 (#63496)
summary: Reorders panic handling in `IndexNestedLoopHashJoin.finishJoinWorkers` to record `panicErr` before canceling the worker context, avoiding nondeterministic `context canceled` returns from `getResultFromChannel` when a worker panics (e.g., OOM/cancel-as-panic paths). Reviewed surrounding ctx/result channel handling and later history up to `upstream/master`; no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
